identityAnchor.purpose: Lineage metadata only; not authentication, ownership proof, or a cryptographic signature.

evidencePolicy: Reported claims are retained for audit but are not represented as verified unless repository evidence supports the exact measurement and scope. A null verifiedValue means no independently verified value is recorded.

records.unit: logical steps / second (1 Hz contract; not measured wall-clock latency)
records.methodology: The engine uses a fixed logical step interval of 1000 ms and deterministic replay tests. This defines simulation step semantics, not an observed one-second execution schedule or measured latency; the host must schedule calls.
evidenceSource: max-core/simulation/engine.ts (stepMs is 1000; host scheduling is documented)
docs/architecture/edge-runtime-wiring.md (Workers do not guarantee a continuously running one-second wall-clock loop)
records.confidenceLevel: Contract behavior is supported by repository code/tests; wall-clock frequency and the reported 99.8% runtime verification are not established.
